scope: Real temporary SQLite/auth/quota/core worker/private object/PDF on the isolated personal UI worktree. Delivery loss/holds and explicitly named structured status responses are browser transport doubles; no providers.

checks.name: Real invalid-access401 is refreshed once during personal initialization; own rotation preserves context
Double click sends one real generation; a lost committed response replays the same key/result and consumes one credit
Displayed plan downloads its exact persisted PDF after a newer plan exists, with real Bearer/object bytes
Explicit next intention uses a fresh UUID and consumes exactly one additional confirmed credit
Actual exhausted personal quota returns a readable structured error and cannot create or blindly retry a new operation
Real impossible exclusions produce a definitive failed generation and conserved quota; after profile repair an explicit new UUID succeeds
A real committed old generation delivered late cannot render private data or overwrite a newly selected account
History downloads an older exact plan ID instead of latest
A real old PDF delivery after account replacement creates no Blob download and clears previous history
Late real history JSON is discarded after account replacement
Legacy gym-type team member generates and downloads under own personal subject; foreign owner plan is404
Named browser response double generation_in_progress keeps same UUID and exposes history/retry without a blind new generation
Named browser response double generation_reconciliation_required keeps same UUID and exposes history/retry without a blind new generation
